definition: The alleged abuser withholds necessary care or assistance for his or her current partner who is incapable of self-care physically, psychologically or culturally, although the caregiver is financially able to do so or has been offered other means to do so.

criteria.label: A
criteria.description: ALL of the following conditions must be present:

elements.label: A. 1
elements.description: The alleged abuser withholds or withholds the partner's access to any of the following:

sub_elements.label: a
sub_elements.description: Appropriate medically indicated health care, including but not limited to appropriate medical, mental health or dental care;

sub_elements.label: b
sub_elements.description: Appropriate nourishment, shelter, clothing, or hygiene; or

sub_elements.label: c
sub_elements.description: Caregiving for more than 24 hours without having arranged for an appropriate surrogate caregiver.

elements.label: A. 2
elements.description: The alleged abuser is able to provide care, or access to care, or has been offered assistance to do so.

elements.label: A. 3
elements.description: The partner is incapable of self-care due to substantial limitations in one or more of the following areas:

sub_elements.label: a
sub_elements.description: Physical, including, but not limited to, quadriplegia;

sub_elements.label: b
sub_elements.description: Psychological or Intellectual, (including, but not limited to, vegetative depression, very low intelligence, psychosis; or

sub_elements.label: c
sub_elements.description: Cultural, including, but not limited to, inability to communicate, inability to manage activities of rudimentary daily living due to foreign culture).

rows.label: A. 1
rows.short_description: The alleged abuser withholds the spouse's access to basic needs

rows.label: A. 2
rows.short_description: The alleged abuser is able to provide care, or access to care, or has been offered assistance to do so

rows.label: A. 3
rows.short_description: The spouse is incapable of self care due to substantial limitations in physical, psychological or cultural functioning

rows.label: B. 2
rows.short_description: Reasonable potential for more than inconsequential physical injury

rows.label: First Time Exclusion (FTE)
rows.short_description: Meets criteria; however, first time incident with no significant risk, physical injury and/or psychological impact.

overall_decision.label: Overall Substantiation Finding
overall_decision.description: Did this case end up meeting all criteria for the type of maltreatment?

egregious_error.label: The committee made an egregious error in voting.
